slides.title: What do Addis Ababa residents say about youth arrests?

slides.text: The Rio Times reports residents say **plain-clothes officers** detained **young people** in recent weeks; the report **could not confirm** this.
One resident says his brother, stopped on an errand, was held for **three days** without a clear explanation.
The Rio Times found **no statement** from the federal government, city administration or police, and it is **not known** why people were held.
The **Ethiopian Human Rights Commission** documented similar detentions of young people in **Oromia** in **Dec 2024**.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: The Rio Times (Nov 10, 2026), citing residents; EHRC (Dec 2024). Not independently verified
